key_expressions: I'm here to open a new account,
Let me show you my ID,
Could you tell me about the fees?,
Can I apply for online banking as well?,
How do I make an international transfer?,

A: Hi, I'd like to open a new account.
Sure, what documents do I need?
Great, then I’ll go ahead and open one now.
B: Hello! You want to open an account? I can help you with that.
You only need your ID. That’s all.
Perfect. Please wait just a moment.

A: Can I apply for online banking at the same time?
Oh, that’s simpler than I expected.
Then I'd also like to set up automatic payments.
B: Yes, you can apply for it while opening your account.
All you need to do is fill out this form.
Sure. I'll guide you through the auto-payment options too.

A: Does this account support international transfers?
I see, so the transfer limit is restricted.
Then can I request a higher limit later?
B: Yes, international transfers are available, but there's a default limit.
If needed, you can complete extra verification steps.
Absolutely. You can request it anytime.

A: Can I also get a debit card issued today?
Oh, so it gets delivered to my address.
Alright, please submit the application for me.
B: Sure. You can apply for a debit card right after opening your account.
Yes, delivery usually takes about five days.
I'll process that for you now.

A: How much are the service fees?
Oh, so the fees are waived if I maintain a certain balance.
Then I guess I should keep that minimum balance.
B: Standard accounts have basic transfer fees.
Yes, but they’re waived if you maintain the required balance.
Exactly. That’s the most convenient option.

A: Can I get the passbook issued right away?
Wow, that’s fast!
Alright, I'll wait just a bit.
B: Yes, we can print it for you on the spot.
It only takes one or two minutes.
I’ll call your name shortly.

A: Can I check my automatic payment history?
Oh, I didn’t notice that menu.
Got it. I’ll check it again at home.
B: Yes, you can view it on the banking app.
You'll find it under the ‘Account Management’ section.
If you have trouble, feel free to ask again!

A: I’d like to print my recent transaction history.
Yes, one month of records is enough.
Perfect. Thanks for your help!
B: Sure, how many months do you need?
Alright, I’ll print your last month's transactions.
Please wait just a moment.

A: Can I switch to a mobile OTP?
Wow, that sounds so much more convenient.
Great. I’ll apply for it now.
B: Yes, most customers use mobile OTP these days.
Once you install the app, the verification completes quickly.
Let me walk you through the setup steps.

A: Will the waiting time be long?
Oh, that’s good. I’m on a tight schedule today.
Alright. I’ll wait over there.
B: Right now, things are moving pretty quickly.
I should be able to assist you soon.
Please have a seat and wait comfortably.
